reasons: The selector uses otel_metric_type="gauge", but container.cpu.usage.usermode is a monotonic sum and the dataset only has dataset_types [sum], so the selector matches nothing.
The promql applies a numeric constant (/ 1e7) that is not in the Datadog source, which the hard rules forbid. The ns-to-percent scale belongs in notes with a documentation link, not in promql.
Using rate() on the cumulative sum and avg by (container_name) matches the Datadog per-container avg by {container_name} grouping, so the quantity, aggregation and grouping are sound.
The unit differs: the OTel metric is cumulative nanoseconds, while docker.cpu.user is a percentage, so the scale must be handled as a documented note rather than an applied constant.
